description: Implementation of the TestCookieAccessDelegate class, which manages cookie access semantics, first-party set metadata, and related cookie policies within the net namespace.

classes.name: TestCookieAccessDelegate
classes.description: A class that provides cookie access semantics, manages first-party sets, and handles restrictions for testing purposes within the net namespace.

methods.name: GetAccessSemantics
methods.description: Returns the access semantics for a given cookie based on expectations.

methods.name: ShouldIgnoreSameSiteRestrictions
methods.description: Determines if same-site restrictions should be ignored for a given URL and site context.

methods.name: ComputeFirstPartySetMetadataMaybeAsync
methods.description: Computes first-party set metadata asynchronously or synchronously based on internal flags.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntry
methods.description: Finds the first-party set entry for a given site.

methods.name: FindFirstPartySetEntries
methods.description: Finds first-party set entries for a set of sites.

methods.name: RunMaybeAsync
methods.description: Executes a callback asynchronously if configured, otherwise returns the result directly.

methods.name: SetExpectationForCookieDomain
methods.description: Sets expected access semantics for a specific cookie domain.

methods.name: SetIgnoreSameSiteRestrictionsScheme
methods.description: Configures whether to require secure origins for certain schemes.

methods.name: GetKeyForDomainValue

methods.name: SetFirstPartySets
